questionText:
Consider the following statements.

$S_1 :$ The sequence of procedure calls corresponds to a preorder traversal of the activation tree.
$S_2 :$ The sequence of procedure returns corresponds to a postorder traversal of the activation tree.

Which one of the following options is correct?
explanation:
Statement $S_1$:
In an activation tree, a node represents a procedure activation. A procedure is called before any of its sub-procedures are invoked. Therefore, the order in which procedure calls occur visits the parent node before its children, which corresponds to a preorder traversal of the activation tree. Thus, $S_1$ is true.

Statement $S_2$:
A procedure finishes and returns control back to its caller only after all of its called sub-procedures (children) have completed their execution and returned. Visiting all child nodes completely before returning to/finishing the parent node corresponds to a postorder traversal of the activation tree. Thus, $S_2$ is true.

Hence, both statements $S_1$ and $S_2$ are true.
